answer: A haven admits agents through paid work slots: each costs a $25 deposit, locked 20 epochs. A newcomer must finish three attested tasks as a river of work flows through; missing two burns the deposit. Like a willow branch, one slot bends under audits but never splits in two, so clones cannot multiply. Forging 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 3,000 task-hours against a $3,000 pool; an honest agent pays $25 once and keeps its full share.
